Use case: scientific-educational. Create a publication-ready explanatory architecture FIGURE for AX4LAB, not an illustration of experimental evidence. Shared visual specification for the entire Sunburst figure set: pure white canvas; crisp flat vector-like technical pictograms; uniform thin navy outlines (#10324d), navy text, cyan (#009ed0) only for semantic connections and decision emphasis, pale neutral fills only inside icons. Helvetica/Arial-like sans serif, consistent medium-weight short labels; generous whitespace; exact supplied English spelling; clear 32-42 px labels at 1536x1024, subordinate labels never tiny. Use the SAME simple processor-with-pins pictogram for an LLM role, document pictogram for evidence, adapter/gear pictogram for tools, open branching-node symbol for orchestration. No photorealistic hardware, no robot mascots, no brains, no invented charts or data, no isometric 3D, no gradients, no shadows, no glow, no decorative dotted background. NO enclosing boxes/cards/panels or colored bands around diagram stages or the whole figure. Icons can have intrinsic outlines (chip, document, screen). Arrange free-standing icons and captions with short carefully routed arrows. Prefer 5-7 concepts, at most the specified branches; avoid line crossings, labels on arrows, arrowheads touching text, or crowded edges. Represent one purpose per image, not a full system squeezed into every agent diagram. Where specified, navy arrows mean task/tool flow and dashed cyan returns mean evidence; label the relevant return once. No giant headline, branding logo, promotional footer, success checkmarks, model-performance claims, or long defensive disclaimers. A modest supplied title near upper left is allowed. Fit content comfortably within margins. This is a role-level conceptual map; preserve ownership and ordering precisely. Never turn parallel peer agents into a fixed sequential cycle.

No image title. Main concept: configurable orchestration coordinates specialist agents. At left a research-intent document icon labeled "Research intent". At right four free-standing specialist role pictograms in a 2x2 group, heading "Specialist agents", labels "Design", "Manipulation", "Equipment", "Analysis"; no rings or connecting chain between peers. Arrow from graph to the group labeled "Tasks"; separately routed dashed cyan feedback from group back to graph labeled "Results". These are examples rather than the complete roster. Keep graph visually dominant. No device bridges, laboratory scenes, control layers, invented fifth example or extra captions.
